Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. Owen thanked Mia for the honest advice. Also, the room list is on the notice board.

Mia advised Owen to try singing as a new hobby. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Owen has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. I ride my bike to school.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The train station has become an important part of daily life. Owen's dream job is to be a engineer. What's more, the castle is the town's main attraction.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Mia always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
